SNF_RETENTION (lines 30-38) holds pre-round 12h, encounter 12h, note 18h, done task 16h, and transcript, previous-note and medication visit counts of 3. hospitalLifecyclePatch and snfLifecyclePatch read every window through these objects. I searched apps/web (convex and src) for hour arithmetic (N * HOUR, 60*60*1000, 12/16/18/36 hours). Context only: open tasks and handoffs (36h in…
Product issue (from physicianImpact): To lengthen any retention window (for example under a hospital affiliation), a developer has to edit lifecycle.ts and release new code; an admin cannot change it in settings or the environment. The 18h "not mentioned today" medication label lives separately in the web client, so it needs its own client change and release. / If the Nursing Home previous-notes window were lengthened in the server config, the Previous Notes panel would still stop the physician adding a note at 3 and show "3/3", so the app would not behave the same everywhere. NH: going offline inside the 800 ms autosave keeps a device copy (one put, no delete); (b) F is restored on the phone and reaches the computer, draft row gone after the echo; (a) the computer's later G wins and F is dropped silently (record-only, Q11). That path is local and does not depend on how the network is cut, so it should hold on a real phone in airplane mode — still worth one device check.
Product issue: Hospital pre-round (and every Hospital autosave field that saves through the same optimistic rounding.update): a line typed just before the phone loses signal (within the 0.8 s autosave) is lost if the app is closed before the signal returns — on reopening, the pre-round notes and the computer show nothing of it, while the same flow in Nursing Home restores it. The device copy is written and then deleted at once by the local optimistic echo (Patient.tsx:33 + useAutosave.ts:101-110), before the server has the text. Breaks Empty & Failure States 'nothing typed is lost' (TC-25 S28 b).
